name: Attic Insulation Payback Calculator
description: Estimate attic insulation project cost, annual energy savings and simple payback period.
search_intent: Estimate whether adding attic insulation can pay back through energy-cost savings.
calculation: Gross project cost = attic area × installed cost per area. Net project cost = max(0, gross project cost - rebates). Annual savings = annual heating/cooling cost × savingsPercent/100. Monthly savings = annual savings / 12. Simple payback years = net project cost / annual savings when annual savings > 0; otherwise null/not applicable.
limitations: This is a simple-payback estimator and not a building energy simulation.
Actual energy savings depend on climate, existing insulation, air sealing, HVAC efficiency and occupant behavior.
